fact: The LCA/ITU sector review (data collected August 2016) states that Lesotho's operators draw international bandwidth from the WACS, EASSy and SEACOM cables, which Lesotho, being landlocked, reaches via South Africa: Vodacom Lesotho via its group's ownership of WACS and EASSy, Econet Telecom Lesotho via SEACOM and EASSy capacity through Liquid Telecom's terrestrial fibre.

The LCA 2010/11 annual report states that the EASSy submarine cable was completed ahead of schedule, Lesotho being a participant, and that the country is now connected through terrestrial backhaul (dated by the 2010/11 reporting year; the document gives no month).
